slug: 2025-12-01 Implementing a Comprehensive Digital Addressing System - Kanifing Municipality, The Gambia

facts.fact: LoGRI says Kanifing Municipality implemented a Plus Code digital addressing system for 500,000 residents, georeferencing 36,000 properties and creating a municipal address database.
facts.system: Kanifing Plus Code digital addressing system

facts.fact: LoGRI says Kanifing Municipal Council now uses the address system for waste management and property-tax collection.
